children.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Cuchara
children.summary: Bosland cycling, the Achel abbey, plus an honest map of what the 30 km circle around Tournier's two-star kitchen does and doesn't include.

children.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Cuchara
children.summary: Hotel Corbie at ~150 m and Mi Casa Naranja at ~4 min walk are the only true walk-back-from-dinner options.

children.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Cuchara
children.summary: Five characterful stays inside a one-taxi hop: a 1904 engineer's villa, a Sahara-edge B&B, a forest-fringe boutique, a glamping tent, a 1957 farm.

children.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Cuchara
children.summary: Nearly every IT event in radius runs on Eindhoven's High Tech Campus; Hasselt/Genk fall just outside.

sources.title: Cuchara — Restaurant
sources.claim: Lepelstraat 3, pedestrian street, partners Corbie / Wilgenhuys / Ars Vivendi, Taxi Flament +32 475 86 53 10.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — Cuchara
sources.claim: Two MICHELIN Stars in the 2026 Belgium guide; Tournier opened it in 2009 in his grandparents' house.

sources.title: Visit Lommel — Cuchara
sources.claim: Dining room moved to the rear building in 2015; stately family building on Lepelstraat.

sources.title: Hotel Corbie Lommel
sources.claim: Hertog Janplein 68, 35 modern rooms and studios, large parking.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Corbie Hotel
sources.claim: 3.4/5 (68 reviews), $196–205/night, walking distance to Cuchara.

sources.title: Mi Casa Naranja
sources.claim: Molsekiezel 24; three luxury rooms; €90–120/night; breakfast €20.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Mi Casa Naranja
sources.claim: 4.9/5 (8 reviews); Cuchara approx 4 minutes' walk; walkability 76/100.

sources.title: B&B 't Wilgenhuys
sources.claim: Jacob Smitsdreef 2; 'only a few minutes from the centre'; forest-adjacent.

sources.title: Booking.com — 't Wilgenhuys
sources.claim: Rated 9.6 by recent guests; cycling junction 25 m away; 2 km from Lommel centre.

sources.title: B&B Ars Vivendi
sources.claim: 1904 engineer's villa, Werkplaatsen 47, three en-suite rooms, garden under century-old beeches.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Ars Vivendi
sources.claim: #1 special lodging in Lommel, 5.0★ Travelers' Choice; 'won't be an ordinary weekend away'.

sources.title: Boutique Hotel Eikenhoef
sources.claim: Opened summer 2023; surrounded by coniferous forest; between cycling junctions 264/265.

sources.title: Eikenhoef — Practical
sources.claim: Knapenhoef 42; check-in from 15:00; breakfast 07:00–10:00 wk / 08:00–10:00 wkn.

sources.title: Booking — Eikenhoef reviews
sources.claim: 9.4/10 over 275 verified reviews; spacious modern rooms, hospitality.

sources.title: Visit Limburg — Sahara
sources.claim: Free entry; Reus van Bosland watchtower; dog off-leash zone; children's play forest.

sources.title: Reus van Bosland — Tripadvisor
sources.claim: 30 m tower, 4.6/5 over 253 reviews, ranked #1 of 24 things to do in Lommel.

sources.title: Cycling Through the Trees
sources.claim: Double circular bridge rising to 10 m; 700 m one-direction route opened June 2019.

sources.title: Visit Lommel — CTT
sources.claim: 12 km by bike from Lommel; Parking Soeverein loop 38.7 km; House of Nature loop 50.7 km.

sources.title: Routiq — Lommel→Bokrijk
sources.claim: Lommel→Bokrijk is 43.66 km by bike, ~44 km by road — Cycling Through Water sits outside 30 km.

sources.title: Eikenhoef — Knapenhoef 42
sources.claim: Parks you on cycling junction 264/265, gateway to the Pijnven loop.

sources.title: Hoeven Het Gehucht
sources.claim: 1957 children's farm in Pelt; on the edge of Bosland; Hageven reserve next door.

sources.title: Natuurpunt — Hageven-De Plateaux
sources.claim: 600 ha cross-border reserve; eight walks; 1.38 km wheelchair-accessible Hubert Lehaenpad.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Lommel-Werkplaatsen
sources.claim: 1904–1914 garden city of ~75 listed workers' and managers' dwellings around the former zinc works.

sources.title: Achelse Kluis — Brasserie
sources.claim: Abbey-brasserie on the Dutch border; 5° Blond is draft-only on-site.

sources.title: BeerTourism — Achelse Kluis
sources.claim: 5° Blond available only on draught at the abbey itself.

sources.title: Rome2Rio — Lommel→Eindhoven
sources.claim: 30.2 km road to the urban edge; 47 km to the centre.

sources.title: DistanceFromTo — Lommel→Hasselt
sources.claim: Hasselt is ~33 km from Lommel — outside the radius.

sources.title: NeedCalc — Lommel→Genk
sources.claim: Lommel to Genk is 32 km — outside the radius.

sources.title: High Tech Campus — Events
sources.claim: Nearly every IT event inside the radius runs at HTC Eindhoven.

sources.title: HTC Open Day 13 Jun 2026
sources.claim: Free, 11:00–16:00, no registration — closest tech weekend after 30 May.

sources.title: Hart van Limburg — Asparagus
sources.claim: Dutch white-asparagus season runs mid-April to 24 June.

sources.title: Visit Flanders — Sahara walk
sources.claim: 11.70 km red-triangle loop from House of Nature; Reus van Bosland 30 m tower.

sources.title: Bosland — Fietsen door de Bomen
sources.claim: Free, sunrise to sunset; gradient 3–4%; accessible to wheelchairs.
